decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template was publicly recommended at launch, sits close to the core agency hosting offer, and costs little to maintain, so management sticks with it.
The responsive website template complements the hosting platform at low upkeep, and any weak uptake can be put down to a temporary ramp-up phase.
Premium support embodies the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service strategy, making it central and highly committed.
The version management tool reflects in-house development investment and was presented on its own page, so sunk costs and visible commitment favor persistence.

Although distant from the core, the data processing contract tool was built as a multi-model line with its own page, and GDPR-driven demand gives management reason to attribute any weakness to temporary causes.
